overview.title: Overview
overview.description: The application shell. Business screens arrive in later phases; what is complete here is the frame every one of them will use.
overview.shellBody: A sidebar driven by configuration, a header, breadcrumbs, a page title with actions, an optional supporting panel, and the loading, empty, error, denied and not-found states every screen needs.
overview.brandBody: The name, logo and palette are placeholders. Replacing them changes configuration and tokens only — no component in this frame reads a brand value.
state.empty.title: Nothing here yet
state.empty.description: Once records exist they will be listed here.
state.noResults.title: No matches
state.noResults.description: No records match the current filters. Clearing one may widen the result.
state.error.title: Something went wrong
state.error.description: The request did not complete. Trying again is safe.
state.denied.title: You do not have access
state.denied.description: Your account does not have permission for this. An administrator can grant it.
state.notFound.title: Not found
state.notFound.description: This page does not exist, or the link that led here is out of date.
state.unavailable.title: Service unavailable
state.unavailable.description: The service is not responding. This is usually brief.
state.conflict.title: Someone else changed this
state.conflict.description: The record changed while you were editing. Reload to see the current version before saving.
state.expired.title: Your session has ended
state.expired.description: Sign in again to continue. Unsaved changes on this page will be lost.
gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.description: Every shared component, in both directions, with deterministic fixtures. No customer or operational data appears here.
